name: Marching Cubes with Histogram Pyramids
aliases: Smooth voxel surface using histogram pyramids
definition: A 3D surface reconstruction method that uses histogram pyramids to reduce redundant voxels (unused for generating the 3D surface) before applying the marching cubes algorithm, resulting in smoother surfaces and lower mesh density.
summary: Marching Cubes with Histogram Pyramids reduces redundant voxels before surface extraction to produce smoother, lower-density meshes with faster rendering than standard Marching Cubes.
